blocks.source: ダンジョンRPGの進捗&テーマ曲
完成までに数回しか挟む気の無いダンジョンＲＰＧの進捗状況です。
blocks.translation: Here is the progress on the dungeon RPG, which I only plan to cover a few more times before completion.

blocks.source: 職業選択画面です。１２の職業（性別有）から４人を選択します。ドラクエの勇者のような存在はなく、主人公もこの中から選びます。その方が自由度が高くて良いのではなかろうかと。一応、主人公は能力が上がりやすいとか何とか特典を付ける予定です。
blocks.translation: This is the class selection screen. You choose four characters from 12 classes (with genders). There is no Dragon Quest-style Luminary, and you choose the protagonist from among these classes as well. I thought that would provide greater freedom. For now, I plan to give the protagonist some kind of bonus, such as having their abilities increase more easily.

blocks.source: まだ途中なので、職業説明は書いていません。
blocks.translation: It's still a work in progress, so I haven't written the class descriptions yet.

blocks.source: 名前入力画面です。入力した名前は自作戦闘や会話にきちんと反映されます。
blocks.translation: This is the name input screen. The name you enter is properly reflected in the custom battles and dialogue.

blocks.source: 当たり前なことの様に思えますが、これをツクールの仕様で実装するのは結構大変です。でも、ツクールをやらない人には何が大変なのか理解してもらえないのが悲しいところ。
blocks.translation: It may seem obvious, but implementing this within RPG Maker's specifications is quite difficult. The sad part is that people who don't use RPG Maker can't understand what makes it so difficult.

blocks.source: 舞台は１つの島になります。真ん中の洞窟にひたすら潜って行くわけですね。
blocks.translation: The setting will be a single island. You'll simply keep descending into the cave at its center.

blocks.source: 色々と施設があるので、パッと見で分かるようなシンボルにしたいところです。
blocks.translation: There are various facilities, so I want to give them symbols that can be recognized at a glance.

blocks.source: 森のマップチップやカエルのキャラチップを自作してみました。
blocks.translation: I tried making my own forest tiles and frog character sprites.

blocks.source: 自作戦闘です。今回は１２×２もキャラがいるので、顔グラはご勘弁。キャラチップを切り取って順番表示するようにしています。
blocks.translation: This is a custom battle system. Since there are as many as 12×2 characters this time, please excuse the lack of face graphics. I cut out the character sprites and display them in sequence.

blocks.source: なお、ラスボスはオリジナルです。姉が頑張ってくれましたので乞うご期待。
blocks.translation: The final boss, however, is original. My older sister worked hard on it, so please look forward to it.

blocks.source: 音楽は全てフリー素材を使用する気でしたが、今のＨＮとしてはせっかくの第一作なので作品のテーマとなる曲を作って見ました。ダンジョンに潜っている時以外は大体この曲が流れます。慣れないギターの打ち込みにも挑戦。アコーディオンいいですよね。
blocks.translation: I had planned to use free music for everything, but since this is my first work under my current handle, I decided to make a song that would serve as the theme for the game. This song plays most of the time when you're not exploring the dungeon. I also took on the challenge of programming a guitar part, which I'm not used to. Accordions are great, aren't they?

blocks.source: 他にもラスボス曲を自作しています。曲数は少ない分、気合入れて作っていますので、こちらも乞うご期待。
blocks.translation: I've also made an original song for the final boss. There aren't many tracks, but I'm putting a lot of effort into them, so please look forward to this one as well.

blocks.source: さすがに１０月は無理そうなので、目指せ１１月完成です。といっても、年内であれば十分なので焦ることもないのですが。ダンジョンRPGの肝はやはりゲームバランスでしょうから、じっくりやりたいところです。
blocks.translation: October looks too difficult after all, so I'm aiming to finish in November. That said, finishing by the end of the year would be more than enough, so there's no need to rush. The key to a dungeon RPG is surely its game balance, so I want to take my time with it.
